title: Use real added flow rather than a restriction of native paths
statement: The actual composite path map preserves native density history and yields the infimum of the native current action over its preimages. Active contraction subtracts the optimized difference-current cost that passive restriction retains. The auxiliary marginal does not erase native information or work, and an o(N^2) tracking theorem alone gives no N^(3/2)-scale CLT.

assumptions: Actual bounded-drift/bounded-activity native law, noninvasive separate counters, conditional fresh sources and a computable bounded-derivative evaluator are supplied. evidence.quote: **Verdict.** The main theorem in Sections 2--7 is accepted at the stated actual operation, conditional-noise, evaluator, clock and detector interfaces, with globally bounded derivatives. I reconstructed the nonlinear disturbance, both supplier connections, the spatial conservation estimate and the path-space map. No load-bearing counterexample was found. Two wording qualifications below prevent stronger claims from being inferred: the optional derivative localization needs its explicit stopping argument, and retention of the macroscopic auxiliary current is not retention of every fine controller log. Neither requires changing the central construction.
